title: Secrets Guardian Terraform module for KMS/HSM and Vault/Secrets Manager integration
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a reusable, well-documented Terraform module (Secrets Guardian) that provides opinionated integrations between customer KMS/HSMs and secret backends (HashiCorp Vault and cloud Secrets Managers) for Redwood Private (VPC) deployments. The module should be suitable for on-prem and VPC deployments, support HSM-backed key references, provide lifecycle hooks for upgrades, and expose health-check endpoints for automated monitoring and self-heal orchestration. The goal is to reduce manual runbooks for secrets provisioning and rotation, enable deterministic upgrades, and provide observability for drift or availability issues.
objectives: Provide a versioned Terraform module with clear inputs/outputs for: KMS key bindings, HSM connector configuration, Vault transit/secret engines bootstrap, and Secrets Manager proxies
Implement automated health probes (Lambda/container) that validate key availability, Vault connectivity, and secrets sync status
Define an upgrade/migration path and migration tooling to roll keys and rotate secrets with minimal downtime
Ship example usage for common deployment topologies (single-region VPC, cross-region failover, and air-gapped on-prem)
Add comprehensive docs, acceptance tests, and CI checks for provider versions and policy drift detection
tasks: Design module API: variables, outputs, and optional submodules for 'hsm_connector' and 'secrets_backend'
Implement core resources for KMS/HSM references and Vault bootstrap (policies, auth method setup, transit configuration)
Create optional Secrets Manager adapter with least-privilege IAM templates and sync job config
Add healthcheck submodule: small service that performs key unwrap/sign, Vault read, and replication sanity checks
Write migration scripts for existing stacks to opt-in to Secrets Guardian with no secret re-encryption by default
Write unit and integration tests: terraform validate, terratest flows against a CICD dev account, and local Vault container
Draft docs: quickstart, upgrade guide, operational runbook, and troubleshooting section
Security review and threat modeling for HSM and Vault network patterns
acceptance_criteria: Module publishes semantic version v1.0.0 with changelog and pinned provider constraints
Example stacks can provision KMS/HSM references and register Vault transit keys using the module
Healthcheck service returns HTTP 200 and a JSON status when keys and backends are reachable (automated test)
Upgrade guide validated: rolling key rotation succeeds in integration test without breaking consumer routes
Security review completed and findings resolved or triaged
Docs and example repos published in the internal docs site and sample-terraform-private repo
implementation_notes: Prefer a layered module: root 'secrets_guardian' that composes 'kms_binding', 'hsm_connector', 'vault_bootstrap', and 'secrets_adapter' optional modules
Expose a 'health_endpoint' output (url) and optional 'health_lambda' boolean to toggle managed probe vs customer-managed probe
Design variables for pinning provider versions and a 'compatibility_matrix' output so runtime teams can map module version -> provider versions
Keep secret material out of state where possible: store only references and use data sources that avoid plain-text secrets in tfstate
Add lifecycle ignore_changes for rotation-managed attributes and provide explicit 'force_rotate' variable for migration scenarios
Document recommended IAM policies for Secrets Manager adapter with least privilege and explain trade-offs for cross-account roles
risks_mitigation: Risk: accidental export of secret material into state. Mitigation: use data sources, mark sensitive outputs, and document state encryption and remote backend requirements.
Risk: HSM vendor API differences. Mitigation: provide small provider-abstraction layer and vendor test matrix; start with one validated vendor implementation and add adapters.
Risk: Vault unavailability during upgrades. Mitigation: provide canary rollout steps, preflight health checks, and automatic rollback hooks in CI pipelines.
Risk: drift between module and environment. Mitigation: include drift-detection job and clear remediation playbooks in the module README
migration_plan: Phase 1: Publish module v0.1 with 'read-only' mode that registers existing keys without rotating them
Phase 2: Enable healthcheck and monitoring only in non-prod environments; run for 2 weeks to collect telemetry
Phase 3: Provide opt-in rotation tooling to rewrap secrets behind HSM-backed keys for a controlled subset of customers
Phase 4: Document rollback steps and add automated preflight checks to the CI gate before any production upgrade
